Subject: Post-call next steps — short window to rebook technical deep dive

Hi Timothy / Sabrina —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we learned: StratTech is prioritizing consistent inference latency for customer-facing features and needs a path to 99th percentile under 300ms for your <8k token use cases.
- Key stakeholders to include: infra (Sabrina), product (Timothy), and an engineering deep-dive owner — recommend Aditya from our solutions team.
- Next step: 45-minute technical deep dive (demo + profiling questions).

We heard you’re headed into a planning offsite this week and wanted to offer a very small set of windows to rebook before we reopen calendars next week. Can you confirm one option within 24 hours or let us know if we should open again?

Proposed (PT):
- Wed 26 May — 10:00–10:45am PT (ideal for infra deep-dive)
- Thu 27 May — 2:00–2:45pm PT (falls in Sabrina’s afternoon slot)
- Fri 28 May — 8:30–9:15am PT (early slot for product & engineering)

If none work, say the word and we’ll add to next-week availability. I’m looping Aditya to coordinate the runbook and bring a short profiling checklist.

Attachments: StratTech-discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today’s discovery)

Thanks —
Sean
